case_title: State vs Accused — Murder under Section 302 IPC
case_facts_preview: Accused allegedly stabbed deceased with sharp weapon. FIR under Section 302 IPC. Eyewitness is brother of deceased. Forensic report shows blood of deceased on accused's clothing.
case_issues: Whether guilt is established beyond reasonable doubt under Section 302 IPC. Reliability of related eyewitness. Evidentiary value of forensic evidence.
